scripts.start: npm run build -w widget && npm start -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w widget && npm run build -w server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w widget && npm run dev -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w widget && npm test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w widget && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.build:extension: npm run build -w widget && node extension/build.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w widget && node e2e/widget.e2e.mjs
